speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is word from the river, mistress. I had it in the lane, with the water, and I did not go down to look.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Say it, and set the water down. I will not have a tale carried dripping.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Apprentices at Billingsgate made the fishwives sell at their own price. By afternoon it is not fish any longer. It is strangers. Dutch and French. A cry from street to street.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You did not go to the river.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I did not. I came home. I am telling you the lane, not the bank.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. We are not a house that goes to look. Eat. Master Shakespeare is not cast today, and he is not going out again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not today, and not tomorrow. I had that before I came home.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat, Gillis. We will not build a sermon on a lane. The loaf is shrunk on the pan, and it is a penny, and that is this table's only price.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am keeping the house. If the cry comes up the street, it will not find me in it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. If it comes, nobody opens to it. Not the maid. Not a lodger. Not a player who thinks he can talk a street into sense.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: If they send me from the loom, I come by the back. Not by the street door.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then come by the back. We will speak when you are in. Not before, and not to the lane.
